title: Overwater Reserve Villa
summary: A private lagoon-front villa with direct water access and protected tenure.
description:
Set on a sheltered lagoon, this villa pairs architectural restraint with a setting that few holdings can match...

## Investment case
- Projected gross yield of 6.2% from a managed short-stay program
- Protected tenure with a 99-year secure lease structure
- Full-service management available on request

The residence opens to a horizon-edge pool and a deep-water berth, making it equally suited to private use and a vetted rental program.

title: Metropolitan Sky Penthouse
summary: A full-floor penthouse above the central business district.
description:
A full-floor penthouse with 360° skyline exposure, private lift access, and a terrace designed for entertaining.

## Investment case
- Stable demand from corporate leasing in a tier-one metro
- Low outgoings with a recently refit common area
- Strong resale liquidity for this asset class

Finishes are restrained and durable, selected for a managed rental program as much as private enjoyment.

title: Alpine Glasshouse Estate
summary: A glass-walled mountain residence engineered for year-round comfort.
description:
Perched on a quiet ridge, this estate frames a protected valley through floor-to-ceiling glass.

## Investment case
- Seasonal managed-rental demand drives a dependable yield
- Energy-efficient envelope keeps operating costs predictable
- Held within a managed estate with shared security

The lower level hosts a wellness suite and a wine room oriented to the view.

title: Harbor Quay Townhouse
summary: A restored quay-side townhouse steps from the marina promenade.
description:
A period townhouse reimagined behind a protected facade, with mooring access and a south-facing courtyard.

## Investment case
- Strong short-stay demand in a walkable harbor precinct
- Recently refurbished systems lower near-term capex
- Protected streetscape preserves long-term value

Three floors connect via a sculptural stair, with the principal rooms oriented to the water.

title: Coral Bay Residence
summary: An oceanfront residence with a managed rental program in place.
description:
A beachfront villa opening directly to a sheltered bay, designed for a turnkey managed-rental operation.

## Investment case
- In-place managed program currently delivering 6.8% gross yield
- Beachfront position with limited comparable supply
- Hurricane-rated construction and backup systems

The layout separates a guest pavilion from the main house for flexible use.

title: Dune Crest Pavilion
summary: A desert pavilion with passive-cooling design and protected views.
description:
A low-slung pavilion set into a stabilized dune field, designed around passive cooling and shaded courtyards.

## Investment case
- Higher yield tier driven by boutique resort-style rental demand
- Low water and energy load keeps outgoings lean
- Held on a managed plot with shared access

Deep overhangs and cross-ventilation keep the interior comfortable through the hottest months.

title: Old Town Loft Collection
summary: A pair of restored lofts in a protected heritage precinct.
description:
Two interconnected loft residences behind a protected heritage facade, sold as a single holding.

## Investment case
- Two income units on one title improve yield per dollar
- Heritage streetscape supports stable resale value
- Walkable location sustains consistent tenant demand

Original timber and brickwork are preserved behind a fully modernized envelope.

title: Vineyard Hill Estate
summary: A working-adjacent estate on a private hill above protected vines.
description:
A classical estate set above a managed vineyard, with a guest house and a private cellar.

## Investment case
- Lower yield offset by strong long-term appreciation potential
- Land component provides a tangible value floor
- Event-licensing potential for additional income

The grounds include formal gardens, a pool, and a climate-controlled cellar.

title: Cliffside Terrace Home
summary: A terraced coastal home with engineered foundations and sea views.
description:
A terraced residence stepping down a sheltered cliff, engineered for stability and oriented to the horizon.

## Investment case
- Managed short-stay demand supports a steady 6.0% yield
- Engineered foundations and survey-backed tenure
- Limited comparable coastal supply supports value

Each terrace opens to an outdoor room, culminating in a sea-edge plunge pool.
